links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM answers versus expert answers to patient questions
links.effect: Mean (SD) readability consensus score was 10.63 (3.17) for expert answers vs 13.64 (2.22) for LLM answers (P < .001), indicating 10th grade and college reading levels, respectively.
links.quote: The mean (SD) readability consensus score for expert answers was 10.63 (3.17) vs 13.64 (2.22) for LLM answers (P < .001), indicating 10th grade and college reading levels, respectively.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM-generated patient materials relative to appropriate patient level
links.effect: LLM answers scored at college reading level (13.64) vs 10th grade for expert answers (10.63), P < .001.
links.quote: The mean (SD) readability consensus score for expert answers was 10.63 (3.17) vs 13.64 (2.22) for LLM answers (P < .001), indicating 10th grade and college reading levels, respectively.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, completeness, and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 responses to radiation oncology patient questions compared to expert answers; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
